summary: Empires of the North is a standalone card-driven civilization builder in the Imperial Settlers universe, where players draft asymmetric faction decks (Scotsmen, Inuit, Vikings) to build engines of resource production and raid enemy islands. It plays faster and leaner than the original Imperial Settlers, with pre-built decks lowering setup time.
praised: fast, satisfying tableau-building with real faction asymmetry
quick setup thanks to pre-constructed clan decks
criticised: take-that raiding can feel harsh to the player being attacked
some card combos are notably stronger than others
can suffer from swinginess if you're raided early
iconography-heavy cards need a learning session

interaction.detail: Each player builds their own tableau of buildings, but ships let players actively raid opponents' islands to steal resources or damage their engine, and cards are drafted from a shared row, so choices affect what's available to rivals.

scoring.how_you_win: Over three eras you build cards for ongoing benefits and send ships to raid or explore; after the third era, points from buildings, completed raids, and bonus tiles are totaled and the highest sum wins.

_name: Imperial Settlers: Empires of the North
